P38.answer: I cannot securely find a word reading בית. The best candidate is the group on strip 3 (centre strip). In Stage 1 I read it as ר ח (pos 8-9). Looked at again, it is a hooked top-right corner, a long roof, and a dark left leg with a bright curved foot running to the left at the bottom. That fits ב?ת at best. If that is right, the four-letter word after it begins at the right edge of strip 4.
P38.evidence: P38_A, strip 3: a long roof groove with the hook at its right end; at the far left a bright curved stroke runs along the bottom to the left of the left leg (looks like the foot of ת).

P38.answer: ח (left leg reaches the roof). There is no foot to the left, so not ת.
P38.evidence: Strip 4, right unit: the roof's shadow groove runs unbroken over the left leg, and the bright left leg starts right under the roof with no gap of flat surface. Cannot exclude a hairline gap (ה).

P38.answer: cannot tell between מ and ב. The second unit has a roof and two legs, but no base stroke is visible, so it looks more like a second ח/ה than like either מ or ב.
P38.evidence: Strip 4, middle unit: the roof is continuous with the first unit. Verticals at both ends; the bottom zone is plain grain with no horizontal groove. Deciding stroke: a base, which is absent or not visible.

P38.answer: ר (the corner slants and rounds into a diagonal leg; no square projecting roof)
P38.evidence: Strip 4, left unit: the stroke leaves the top right and runs diagonally down to the lower left without a square angle. A separate vertical stands at the far left of the strip. This could also be the right part of א.

P38.answer: cannot tell. The first unit on strip 5 has a short dark top at the strip's right edge and a diagonal groove below it; no clear second leg.
P38.evidence: Strip 5, right edge (enlarged 4x): a dark block at roof height against the edge, then a long diagonal. Neither a free nor a joined left leg can be seen. A better image of the strip junction would be needed.

P38.answer: Revision compared with Stage 1: pos 9 (strip 3) may be ת rather than ח, because a foot is visible at the bottom left. The Stage 1 file is unchanged.

P68.answer: First word: ב (strip 1) followed by the long diagonal stroke, which I read in Stage 1 as ל but which could be part of ש. The ל asked about is most likely on strip 3, right part: a dark stroke rising above the roof line with a bright diagonal tail below it. This is the 'hook/angle' at pos 6 in Stage 1.
P68.evidence: P68_A strip 3, enlarged 3.4x: a dark vertical goes above the line height and joins a bright diagonal sloping down to the left.

P68.answer: ח (left leg appears joined to the roof)
P68.evidence: Strip 3, left unit: the roof groove runs from the left edge of the letter to the ל. A bright left leg hangs straight down from the roof's shadow with no visible gap. The right leg is faint. A free leg (ה) cannot be excluded at this image quality.

P68.answer: Yes, a further box-shaped letter follows on the right of strip 4. It has a top bar, a lower bar at baseline and a right side, so it is a closed box (ם) or ב. The left side is not clear. There is a strip gap before it, and whether a word space lies there cannot be seen.
P68.evidence: Strip 4, right unit: two parallel horizontal grooves (top and base) the same length, with a vertical at the right. A dark zone at the left side may be the closing stroke.

P68.answer: No cancelled letters seen (no strokes drawn through letters, no dots above).
P68.evidence: Strips 1-4 at the target height. Only corrosion pits are visible.

P71.answer: cannot tell. The right third of strip 1 (start of the line) is too faint to separate letters. I cannot decide ר vs ד, ו/י/ר, or the final letter.
P71.evidence: P71_A strip 1, right part, at 4.2x with gentle and high-pass contrast: only diffuse shading and one faint diagonal. A sharper or raking-light image would be needed.

P71.answer: cannot tell. The only ב-like trace I see (a vertical with a base bar, strip 1 left of centre, Stage 1 pos 6) has a diagonal on its RIGHT (pos 5), not on its left. The surface to its left is too faint to show a צ. Its third letter cannot be read.
P71.evidence: Strip 1, centre: a bright vertical with a bright base; to its left only faint grain.

P71.answer: cannot tell. Marks above the line near there seem to belong to the line above; no small superscript letter can be made out.

P79.answer: I take the word beginning ה-ט to start on strip 5 (Stage 1 pos 10-11, read ד then ט). It begins with a roof with a vertical, and a smooth surface to its right looks like a space. The preceding word would then end on strip 4.
P79.evidence: P79_A strip 5 at 4x: the roof has a vertical leg and a large curved stroke follows to its left and below. The surface to its right is plain.

P79.answer: cannot tell. The candidate ק is the right unit on strip 4: a roof with a thin stroke dropping well below the line. The area to its right (strip 4 right edge) is a corroded dark blotch with no countable strokes, so I cannot decide between one flat-based box (מ) and נ+י.
P79.evidence: Strip 4 at 4.2x. The blotch to the right of the roof unit has no base groove that would show a flat-based מ.

P79.answer: After the ק-candidate there is a low, flat base groove with faint marks above it. This could be the base of ב/מ/נ; the letter itself cannot be identified.
P79.evidence: Strip 4, middle unit: a bright upper edge and a deep dark horizontal sitting lower than the neighbouring roofs, with no clear roof above it.

P79.answer: The word appears to end at the left side of strip 4 with a square letter: roof plus base, so ם, ב or מ. It looks closed, so ם is the most likely.
P79.evidence: Strip 4, left unit: a dark square roof groove and a separate dark base groove below, both about one letter wide.

P80.answer: Best candidate: strip 2 (second from right), Stage 1 pos 9-10. Pos 9 is a box with a dark roof and a right vertical (ה). Pos 10, at the left edge of strip 2, is a box with a deep left side, a top and probably a right side (ס-like; I gave ח in Stage 1). An alternative candidate is on strip 5: a ב/ה box, then the ס-like rounded hollow, then a blister.

cannot tell. For the strip 2 candidate, the next sign (strip 3) is a dark box-like depression crossed by thin scratched lines (a +-like and a Π-like sign). No projecting base can be seen, but there is no rounded כ either. For the strip 5 candidate, the letter after ס is hidden by the blister.
P80.evidence: Strip 3 at 5x: a thin horizontal at roof height and thin verticals crossing it, over a dark depression. The thin lines look like scratches or cracks rather than punched strokes.

P80.answer: For the strip 5 candidate: the last sign before the strip ends is a vertical with a hooked head that seems to run below the line, so ן is possible (ו/ז if it is short). For the strip 2 candidate: cannot tell.
P80.evidence: Strip 5, left part at 3.8x: a narrow vertical groove from mid-height to below the baseline, with a small curved head.

P80.answer: Revision compared with Stage 1: pos 10 (strip 2 left edge) looks more like a closed box (ס/ם) than ח. Strip 1 pos 1 ב has a base that projects to the right beyond its right vertical. The Stage 1 file is unchanged.

P82.answer: Uncertain location. Strip 1 (right) reads: a curved hook (ב/נ?), a roof over a rounded bowl (ט/ס, could be נ), a vertical (ר/ו), then a box at the strip's left end. If the ב-נ word is the hook + bowl, the following word is the vertical and the box (Stage 1 pos 4-5). Its last letter is a box with top, base, right side and a probable left side: closed box ם (or ב).
P82.evidence: P82_A strip 1 at 3.8x, left end: top groove and base groove the same length, a vertical at the right and a dark vertical at the left edge. There is no projecting base tail, so not ב by that criterion; there is no round bowl, so not ט.

P82.answer: Strip 2, right to left: a tall dark stroke rising above the line with a low dark box at the strip's right edge (י or ה?), then ר/ד, then ד/ר, then a thin vertical ו, then a small dark blob (י?), then a box with a top bar and two sides at the left edge (ח/ה). (a) First letter: cannot tell between י and ה; the tall stroke suggests י or another letter with an ascender. (b) Second letter: ר possible, because the corner looks rounded and there is no square projection. (c) ו: yes, a thin straight vertical about 4th from the right on strip 2. ח/ה: at the left end of strip 2. Left leg joined or free: cannot tell.
P82.evidence: Strip 2 at 3.7x: three roof grooves at the same height, one thin vertical groove with no roof, and a final box at the edge.

P82.answer: Revision compared with Stage 1: the last unit of strip 2 (Stage 1 pos 12, read ם) may be ח/ה. The Stage 1 file is unchanged.

P85.answer: First word on strip 1: a tall-right-vertical ב-like letter with a long base, then a diagonal with a small lens-shaped hollow, which could be the body and detached leg of ק. The second word starts across the hole on strip 2. Its ל is probably the long diagonal on strip 2 that runs down to the left from above the line.
ה (left leg free, or at least not seen joined)

P85.evidence: Strips 1-3: no strokes drawn through letters, no dots above.

P96.answer: Right fragment (strip 1): ב (box with roof, right vertical and a base), then a tall vertical (it could be the right leg of ח, which matches ב-ח), then a round dark spot at the broken edge.

Then the metal is missing at line height for about 450 px, roughly 7-8 letter widths; no letters can be counted there, and the small V-shaped fragment lies below the line. The next fragment (strip 3) has its upper edge broken over its right part, then roughly 6 thin vertical strokes with short roofs (ח/ה/ת or numeral strokes). Traces of ש, ל, ד, י, א, נ or ב: none visible in the gap. ט possible only as the round trace.
P96.evidence: P96_A: straightened band crop shows the missing metal between x≈1110 and x≈1550 at line height.

P96.answer: cannot tell: the metal is missing.

P99.answer: Possibly ק. At the right edge of strip 1 there is a faint first letter. Then comes a diagonal roof/right side and, separate from it, a dark leg that descends clearly below the baseline. This fits ק.
P99.evidence: P99_A strip 1 right part at 4.6x: the diagonal groove from top right; below and to the left, a separate vertical dark groove reaches the lowest part of the band.

P99.answer: Yes, a tall plain vertical follows (ו).
P99.evidence: Strip 1: a dark vertical groove with no roof, full letter height, just left of the ק-candidate.

P99.answer: In order: ד/ר (roof with right vertical); a ^-shaped pair of diagonals with a dark box-like hollow below it (מ possible, or א); a diagonal at the left end of strip 1; on strip 2, א/צ, then a V-shape (ע probable among the options, or ש), then a roof with verticals (ה/ח), then a box with a right vertical and a base (ב). Where the first word ends cannot be seen; no space is visible.
